Leeds United v Tottenham Hotspur (Kick-off 12.30pm). Coverage of the top-flight match from Elland Road. The visitors are six games unbeaten against the West Yorkshire side, a run that stretches back to November 2021. Leeds' last victory against Spurs saw them pick up a 3-1 win at this ground in May 2021, when goals from Patrick Bamford, Stuart Dallas and Rodrigo gave the Whites all three points.
